description: Commission of Election - Number of members which each electoral district is entitled to return by virtue of the Proclamation under Article 97 and Article 98
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Election Commission certifying the number of members each electoral district is entitled to return, which falls under electoral boundary changes and electoral processes. The document specifically references the Constitution and the Election Commission's authority under Article 98(8) to determine parliamentary representation allocations by district, making this clearly an Elections Gazette.
